product_overview: A modular ERP backend platform providing security, organization master data, master data lookups, notifications, and file services. The system supports JWT-based authentication, role- and permission-driven access, hierarchical org structures, secure file token workflows, and channel-based notifications.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication, authorization, and user management
Support hierarchical organization master data and scoped data access
Enable admin management of pages, permissions, roles, menus, and user profiles
Offer reusable master data lookup tables for cross-module consumption
Deliver secure file upload/download/delete flows using time-limited encrypted tokens
Support notification sending, scheduling, templates, channel configuration, and inbox/history tracking

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to log in, refresh and revoke tokens, self-register, activate accounts, and request password resets.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken and data.expiresIn -> Use JWT for authenticated API calls -> GET /api/menu/user-menu with bearer token -> Receive 200 with menu data
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 error ApiResponse with success=false and error details
POST /api/auth/refresh with valid refresh-token cookie -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken and data.expiresIn -> Continue calling protected endpoints
POST /api/auth/logout with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 204 No Content -> Reusing the old refresh token fails on POST /api/auth/refresh

POST /api/auth/signup with valid username, email, and password -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data signup confirmation and disabled account state -> POST /api/auth/signup/activate with valid activation token -> Receive 200 OK

POST /api/auth/forgot-password with an unknown email -> Receive 200 OK generic ApiResponse without revealing account existence -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with an invalid or expired token -> Receive error ApiResponse
POST /api/auth/reset-password with valid token and new password -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/auth/login with the new password -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken
POST /api/auth/login-token with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data full user info including roles and permissions -> Use returned token data for client bootstrap
POST /api/auth/signup with duplicate username or email -> Receive error ApiResponse with validation or conflict details

features.name: Menu
features.description: Returns the current user's navigation tree filtered by VIEW permissions, and allows admins to inspect another user's menu.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken -> GET /api/menu/user-menu with bearer token -> Receive 200 with MenuItemDto[] in ApiResponse.data

POST /api/auth/login with a low-privilege user -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken -> GET /api/menu/user-menu with bearer token -> Receive 200 with a reduced menu tree based on VIEW permission

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data.accessToken -> GET /api/menu/user-menu/{userId} as an admin -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data MenuItemDto[] for the specified user
GET /api/menu/user-menu without a JWT bearer token -> Receive 401/403 error ApiResponse with success=false

features.name: Pages
features.description: Manages application pages/screens and auto-generates CRUD permissions for each created page.
user_flows: POST /api/pages with valid pageCode, names, route, module, and active=true -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data PageResponse -> Verify auto-generated VIEW, CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE permissions exist for the page
POST /api/pages/search with filters for pageCode, module, or active status -> Receive 200 with paginated PageResponse results in ApiResponse.data
GET /api/pages/active with a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data PageResponse[] for dropdown use
PUT /api/pages/{id} with updated metadata but unchanged pageCode -> Receive 200 with updated PageResponse in ApiResponse.data
PUT /api/pages/{id}/deactivate for an in-use page -> Receive 200 with deactivated PageResponse in ApiResponse.data
PUT /api/pages/{id}/reactivate after deactivation -> Receive 200 with reactivated PageResponse in ApiResponse.data
POST /api/pages with missing required fields or duplicate pageCode -> Receive error ApiResponse with validation or conflict details

features.name: Permissions
features.description: Creates and updates granular permissions attached to pages and permission types.
user_flows: POST /api/permissions with a valid name, pageId, and permissionType -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data PermissionDto -> Use returned permission in role-page assignment flows
POST /api/permissions/search with module or name filters -> Receive 200 with paginated PermissionDto results in ApiResponse.data
PUT /api/permissions/{id} with valid updated values -> Receive 200 with updated PermissionDto in ApiResponse.data
POST /api/permissions with an invalid pageId or duplicate permission definition -> Receive error ApiResponse with success=false and error details
PUT /api/permissions/{id} for a non-existent permission -> Receive 404/400-style error ApiResponse

features.name: Roles
features.description: Creates and manages roles, activates or deactivates them, and manages page-permission assignments and copying.
user_flows: POST /api/roles with valid roleCode, roleName, description, and active flag -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse.data RoleDto -> GET /api/roles/{roleId} returns the created role
POST /api/roles/search with roleName filter -> Receive 200 with paginated RoleDto results in ApiResponse.data
PUT /api/roles/{roleId} with updated roleName or description -> Receive 200 with updated RoleDto while roleCode remains immutable
GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages -> Receive 200 with RolePagesMatrixResponse in ApiResponse.data showing assigned page CRUD permissions
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with pageCode and permissions -> Receive 200 with PageAssignmentResponse in ApiResponse.data -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages shows VIEW added automatically
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with a full replacement matrix -> Receive 200 with RolePagesMatrixResponse reflecting the replacement in ApiResponse.data
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/copy-from/{sourceRoleId} -> Receive 200 with CopyPermissionsResponse in ApiResponse.data -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages reflects copied page-scoped permissions
DELETE /api/roles/{roleId} for a role still referenced by users or assignments -> Receive 409 conflict ApiResponse with role-in-use details
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/activate or /api/roles/{roleId}/deactivate -> Receive 200 with updated RoleDto in ApiResponse.data
POST /api/roles with duplicate roleCode or invalid payload -> Receive error ApiResponse with validation or conflict details

global_conventions: CRITICAL - every JSON response, success or error, is wrapped in a common ApiResponse envelope: {"success": boolean, "message": string, "data": <actual payload>, "timestamp": string, "correlationId": string}. The actual payload (e.g. accessToken, or a created/updated entity) is ALWAYS nested under the top-level "data" key, never at the top level. Example real login response: {"success":true,"data":{"accessToken":"...","expiresIn":900},"message":"OK","timestamp":"...","correlationId":"..."}. Generated test code MUST read response.json()["data"]["accessToken"], NOT response.json()["accessToken"]. This applies to every endpoint below, not just login.
